column1: # 日本語 (ja) interface catalog for DiscCraft, in craft-i18n's layout (storytold/craft-i18n): the strings DiscCraft
# shares with the other Crafting Apps come from common.tsv next to this file, a copy of craft-i18n's shared catalog
# at the commit in ../../craft-i18n.rev. This file holds DiscCraft's own strings, and its overrides of shared ones
# where DiscCraft uses the same English with another meaning (a chapter's Number, a folder's Location:).
# Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> English source text <TAB> translation
#   context  usually empty. `@plural`, `@id` and `@msg` mean something to the apps; any other
#            word is a label that tells apart two meanings of the same English.
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns (in any
#            order), and a trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English text in ordinary
# computing vocabulary, in the shared catalog's words and style. No other product's localisation,
# string table or translated UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
